highlights: Ugreen case box for Nintendo Switch and accessories Size: 26.5 x 10 x 13.5 cm (50275 LP145)
Provides secure storage room for some small nintendo switch accessories
Easier to close and easier to carry
Two soft central dividers protect the screen from being scratched inside the case
Made of top-quality EVA and oxford fabric materials
One pouch is enough to keep your Nintendo video game console and compatible accessories in order.
Meet the Ugreen portable travel case designed to store and transport electronic accessories in the most orderly and safe way. Made of solid materials: EVA and Oxford - waterproof and shock absorbing.
The bottom layer of the case is lined with soft foam, so that the joy-con with the controller and power supply will not be scratched or damaged as a result of moving.
The front side of the center partition with a flexible strip holds the console firmly and steadily. On the back, the manufacturer has used a solution that can accommodate up to 10 game cassettes.
There is a zippered mesh pocket at the top of the bag which offers enough space for extra joy-cones, joy-con straps, earbuds, charging cables, USB flash drives, etc.
